subject: gk
question: A Governor shall, notwithstanding the expiration of his term, continue to hold office until ______________.

options.text: he/she has aid and advice of the Chief Minister

solution:
The correct answer is __**his/her successor enters his/her office**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the **Constitution (Amendment) Bill of 2022**, a Governor remains in office until their successor assumes the position.
 
• Article 156 of the Indian Constitution specifies a five-year term for Governors, who may choose to resign by notifying the President.
